crossRefs.note: The king said to him, “Go in peace.” So he arose, and went to Hebron.

people.name: Hebron
people.line: An important city in Judah; burial place of patriarchs.

translations.web: The king said to him, “Go in peace.” So he arose, and went to Hebron.
translations.bsb: “Go in peace,” said the king. So Absalom got up and went to Hebron.
